markers.name: PORTAL_Arrival
markers.note: Arrival point and ejection portal origin.

markers.name: INT_The_Threshold_Stone
markers.note: Names everyone currently inside the maze.

markers.name: INT_Moss_Map
markers.note: The moss grows in the shape of the maze. It is out of date.

markers.name: INT_Wall_That_Listens
markers.note: Say the right word and it steps aside. The word is elsewhere in the maze.

markers.name: INT_The_Torch_Line
markers.note: Lit torches persist for other players for an hour.

markers.name: INT_Offering_Bowl
markers.note: Give up an item; the maze simplifies for you. Give up an artifact; it opens.

markers.name: INT_The_Repeating_Room
markers.note: The same room four times. One of them has an extra door.

markers.name: INT_Buried_Bell
markers.note: Ringing it resets the maze layout for everyone in it.

markers.name: INT_Paint_Blaster_Cache
markers.note: Yields the Paint Blaster (Art class). Paint marks walls permanently.

markers.name: INT_The_Key_of_Stone
markers.note: Third of the three CORE keys, at the maze's true centre.

markers.name: INT_Exit_That_Moves
markers.note: It is never where you left it.
